description_en: When you need to record Kubernetes API requests and their results to trace cluster operation history or troubleshoot cluster issues, you can invoke the UpdateClusterAuditLogConfig operation to enable or shutdown the audit log feature for a specified ACK cluster and update the audit log configuration
description_zh: 当您需要记录对Kubernetes API的请求以及请求结果来用于追溯集群操作历史、排查集群故障时，您可以调用UpdateClusterAuditLogConfig接口来开启、关闭指定ACK集群的审计日志功能、更新审计日志配置
kebab_example: aliyun cs update-cluster-audit-log-config --clusterid c82e6987e2961451182edacd74faf0000 --sls-project-name k8s-log-c82e6987e2961451182edacd74faf0000 --disable false --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateClusterAuditLogConfig

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to disable the cluster audit log feature. Valid values:
false: enables the audit log feature or updates the audit log configuration.

true: disables the audit log feature
parameters.help_zh:
可以通过该参数开启或关闭集群审计日志功能。
false: 开启审计日志功能或更新审计日志配置。

true: 关闭审计日志功能
parameters.name: disable

parameters.help_en:
The https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/48873.html that contains the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/48874.html for cluster audit logs.

Default value: k8s-log-{clusterid}.

After you enable the cluster audit log feature, a Logstore for cluster audit logs is created in the specified SLS Project.

If you need to change the SLS Project after enabling the cluster audit log feature, use this parameter to specify a new SLS Project. Only ACK managed clusters support changing the SLS Project
parameters.help_zh:
集群审计日志https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/48874.html所在的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/48873.html。

默认值为k8s-log-{clusterid}。

开启集群审计日志功能后会在指定的SLS Project下创建集群审计日志对应的Logstore。

如您开启集群审计日志功能后需要修改SLS Project，可以通过该参数重新指定SLS Project（仅ACK托管集群支持修改SLS Project）
parameters.name: sls_project_name
